description: This file is a header file for a C/C++ project, defining functions related to MLO (Multi-Link Operation) readiness checks for network endpoints. It includes licensing information, include directives, and a function prototype.

methods.name: wld_epMld_isMloReady
methods.description: Function prototype that checks whether a given endpoint (pointer to T_EndPoint) is MLO capable, based on the presence of a single valid MLO profile or shared connection config.
